Bethany's Guacamole
By: Bethany Davis
Published: Sunday, April 17, 2011 - 9:35pm

Ingredients




4 Avocados
2 jalapeños pepper
1 serrano pepper
1 tomato
1 onion
1/4 cup chopped cilantro
1 lime juiced
salt and pepper to taste

Preparation

1 Mash up avocados until as soft as possible in large bowl. 2 Chop up jalapeños and serrano (take seeds and ribs out for less spice), tomato, and onion and add to avocados. 3 Use scissors to chop up a bunch of cilantro to taste into bowl. 4 Add lime juice and salt to taste. 5 Mix thoroughly. 6 Serve with tortilla chips.

About


There are many guacamole recipes out there. This is mine. It's pretty simple, but good, and pretty spicy. I made it based on what I wanted in guacamole. I didn't get it from anyone else.
